kind.description: kind[String]: The SAM kind of the resource that depends on this resource, e.g. LLMClient. Read only.
kind.title: Kind

name.description: name[String]: The name of the resource that depends on this resource. Read only.
name.title: Name

SAMMCPClientMetadata.description: Smarter API MCPClient Manifest - Metadata class.

annotations.description:
The manifest annotations. Used for storing arbitrary metadata as
            key-value pairs. Example: [{'smarter.sh/test-manifest/project-name': 'Scooby dooby do'}]. The
            key should be a valid url-friendly string. The value accepts
            multi-line string values (YAML block scalars) and various scalar types including
            str, int, float, bool, datetime.date, datetime.datetime, decimal.Decimal, uuid.UUID, bytes, list, dict.
annotations.title: Annotations

description.description: The description for this resource. Be brief. Keep it under 255 characters.
description.title: Description

name.description: The camelCase name of the manifest resource
name.title: Name

tags.description: The tags of the manifest. Used for generic resource categorization and search. Example: ['tag1', 'tag2']
tags.title: Tags

version.description: The semantic version of the manifest. Example: 0.1.0
version.title: Version

SAMMCPClientMetadata.title: SAMMCPClientMetadata

config.description: MCPClient.spec.config[object]. The configuration for the MCPClient.

allowedResources.description: MCPClient.spec.config.allowedResources[list]: glob patterns of the resource URIs that the LLM may read, e.g. docs://example.com/* . Empty means none.
allowedResources.title: Allowedresources

allowedTools.description: MCPClient.spec.config.allowedTools[list]: glob patterns of the tool names to offer the LLM, e.g. search_* . Empty means all of the tools that the server advertises.
allowedTools.title: Allowedtools

apiKeyHeader.description: MCPClient.spec.config.apiKeyHeader[str]: the HTTP header that carries an api_key credential.
apiKeyHeader.title: Apikeyheader

authType.description: MCPClient.spec.config.authType[str]: how to authenticate with the MCP server. One of: ['none', 'api_key', 'bearer_token', 'oauth2']. oauth2 sends an OAuth access token, obtained elsewhere, as a bearer token.
authType.title: Authtype

cacheTtl.description: MCPClient.spec.config.cacheTtl[int]: seconds to cache the MCP server's tools, instructions and capabilities. 0 disables caching.
cacheTtl.title: Cachettl

credentials.description: MCPClient.spec.config.credentials[str]: the name of the Smarter Secret containing the credential. Required unless authType is none.
credentials.title: Credentials

endpointUrl.description: MCPClient.spec.config.endpointUrl[str]: the https URL of the MCP server's endpoint.
endpointUrl.title: Endpointurl

headers.description: MCPClient.spec.config.headers[dict]: optional, non-secret HTTP headers to send to the MCP server. Credentials belong in a Smarter Secret, via credentials.
headers.title: Headers

includeInstructions.description: MCPClient.spec.config.includeInstructions[bool]: add the MCP server's instructions to the system prompt.
includeInstructions.title: Includeinstructions

isActive.description: MCPClient.spec.config.isActive[bool]: whether LLMClients use this MCPClient.
isActive.title: Isactive

priority.description: MCPClient.spec.config.priority[int]: the order in which an LLMClient's MCPClients are offered to the LLM. Lower runs first.
priority.title: Priority

timeout.description: MCPClient.spec.config.timeout[int]: seconds to wait for the MCP server to connect and respond.
timeout.title: Timeout

transport.description: MCPClient.spec.config.transport[str]: the MCP transport. One of: ['http', 'sse']. http is Streamable HTTP, and sse is the legacy HTTP+SSE transport.
transport.title: Transport

SAMMCPClientStatus.description:
Smarter API MCPClient Manifest - Status class.

Read only. Besides ownership, it reports the result of the last connection to the MCP server.

accountNumber.description: MCPClient.status.account_number: The account owner of this MCPClient. Read only.
accountNumber.title: Accountnumber

connectionStatus.description: MCPClient.status.connectionStatus: the result of the last connection to the MCP server: unconfigured, connected, disconnected or error. Read only.
connectionStatus.title: Connectionstatus

created.description: The date in which this resource was created. Read only.
created.title: Created

dependencies.description: dependencies[List]: The resources that depend on this resource, and that must be deleted, or stop referring to it, before it can be deleted. Lists only the resources that you can read. Read only.
dependencies.title: Dependencies

lastConnected.description: MCPClient.status.lastConnected: when Smarter last connected to the MCP server. Read only.
lastConnected.title: Lastconnected

lastError.description: MCPClient.status.lastError: the error of the last failed connection, if any. Read only.
lastError.title: Lasterror

modified.description: The date in which this resource was most recently changed. Read only.
modified.title: Modified

protocolVersion.description: MCPClient.status.protocolVersion: the MCP protocol version negotiated with the server. Read only.
protocolVersion.title: Protocolversion

recordLocator.description: recordLocator[String]: An optional identifier used to locate the resource record associated with this manifest. Read only.
recordLocator.title: Recordlocator

serverName.description: MCPClient.status.serverName: the name that the MCP server reported. Read only.
serverName.title: Servername

serverVersion.description: MCPClient.status.serverVersion: the version that the MCP server reported. Read only.
serverVersion.title: Serverversion

tools.description: MCPClient.status.tools: the names of the MCP server's tools that this MCPClient offers the LLM, as of the last connection. Read only.
tools.title: Tools

username.description: MCPClient.status.username: The Smarter user who created this MCPClient. Read only.
username.title: Username

apiVersion.title: Apiversion

kind.description: kind[String]: Required. The kind of resource described by the manifest.
kind.title: Kind
